resources.string: Keep the phone fixed on a stand in a quiet place. Audio is analyzed in memory and discarded. Only numbers stay on the phone, leaving it only when you share them.

Place the UMIK-1 beside the phone microphone and measure the same sound in REW. Measure the room, the PC calibration sound, then a separate validation sound. Each source records the sound for 10 seconds. The PC analyzer combines the export with REW band levels to calculate correction and validation error. Measuring the room again discards both previous sound measurements.

Automatically compares P1, P1+, P1++ and v0.3 at the current system volume for about four minutes. A steady sound and the same sound plus an impact are measured at two levels, three times each. Keep the phone and volume fixed. Test output and virtual bass level are fixed; saved settings stay as they were.
Impact measurements currently use the rootless general app. The rooted app needs its global effect path checked to avoid processing the test sound twice. Microphone comparison remains available.
Saved the result to the selected file.

The recording path is logged and checked. Another labeled source is used when unprocessed recording is unavailable. Results describe the combined speaker, room, body and microphone path, not isolated noise or audible superiority. Nothing is applied to settings.
